## AegisProxy egress gateway
Traffic, threat protection and administration of the server egress proxy. Data: `AegisProxy_CL` (log export destination "Microsoft Sentinel").

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "traffic"
| summarize Requests = count() by Verdict = tostring(Data.verdict)
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests by verdict

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "traffic"
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Verdict = tostring(Data.verdict)
content.title: Requests over time

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "traffic" and Outcome == "failure"
| summarize Blocked = count(), Servers = dcount(ServerName) by Destination, Verdict = tostring(Data.verdict)
| top 20 by Blocked
content.title: Top blocked destinations

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "traffic" and Outcome == "failure"
| summarize Blocked = count(), Destinations = dcount(Destination) by ServerName, ServerIP
| top 20 by Blocked
content.title: Servers with most blocked requests

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "security"
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Type = tostring(Data.type), ServerName, Destination, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Security events

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "audit"
| summarize Events = count() by Action, Actor
| order by Events desc
content.title: Administrative activity

content.query:
AegisProxy_CL
| where Stream == "audit" and Action in ("SERVER_QUARANTINED", "SERVER_RELEASED", "BREAK_GLASS_LOGIN", "POLICY_SET_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH")
| project TimeGenerated, Action, Actor, Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Quarantine and break-glass events
